# EikenTango

> Playful, daily-5-minute vocabulary training for Japan's Eiken exam (currently Pre-1 / 準1級).

EikenTango helps learners master Eiken vocabulary through flashcards, cloze quizzes, and stage-based progression with mastery tracking and streaks.

## Pages
- [Home](/): Landing page introducing flashcards, word list, and quizzes.
- [Study](/study): Stage-based study dashboard with worlds, progress, and weak zone.
- [Word list](/study/list): Browse and filter all vocabulary by world, category, and mastery.
- [Flashcards](/study/flashcards): Tap-to-flip flashcard practice for the current stage.
- [Quiz](/study/quiz): Cloze-style multiple-choice quizzes (mission, weekly, monthly, weakness).
- [Sign in](/auth): Email or Google sign-in / sign-up.
